{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify rows with commas in revenue — these are the QA rows
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Number of such rows
print(f'Number of rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Show the unique values
print(f'Unique revenue values with commas: {sales[has_commas]["revenue"].unique()}')

# Remove these rows
sales_clean = sales[~has_commas]

# Convert revenue to float
sales_clean['revenue'] = sales_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_clean[(sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Output
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
